meta_description: J & S Plastering & Building in Birmingham. Expert plastering, rendering, and building work. Free quotes. Call 07751 083384 today.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterers — Quality Finishes, Fair Prices
hero_subhead: Damp patches and uneven walls drag down your home's value. We deliver smooth, durable finishes that last.
services_heading: Complete Plastering & Building Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From internal dry lining and skimming to external rendering and remedial work, we handle every aspect of plastering and building repair.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Perfect finish to walls and ceilings. We repair cracks, fill holes, and apply smooth skimcoat ready for decoration. Most rooms completed within one or two days.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant external finishes that protect and improve kerb appeal. We use proven render systems suited to Birmingham's climate and your home's age.

services.title: Damp & Remedial Plastering
services.desc: We identify moisture issues and apply specialist plasters and tanking solutions. Includes breathable finishes for period properties and modern moisture barriers for newer builds.

services.title: Dry Lining & Stud Partition
services.desc: Create new rooms or reclaim space with partition walls. Includes insulation and fire-rated boarding where needed. Faster and cleaner than traditional blockwork.

services.title: Ceiling Work
services.desc: Artex removal, boarding over, decorative finishes, and repair of sagging or damaged ceilings. We ensure safe handling of any asbestos-containing materials.

services.title: Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Textured coatings, lime mortar, feature walls, and bespoke finishes to suit period or contemporary properties. Enhances character whilst protecting your investment.

about_pullquote: We do the job once and we do it right—no shortcuts, no comebacks.
about_para_1: J & S Plastering & Building was founded on a simple idea: give local homeowners in Birmingham the honest, skilled plastering they deserve. Over 18 years, we've completed over 2,000 jobs—from small patch repairs to complete house renovations. We're fully equipped and trained in traditional lime work, modern render systems, and specialist damp remediation.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, finishing on schedule, and leaving your home cleaner than we found it. We listen to what you need, quote fairly, and we're not interested in upselling unnecessary work. Most of our business comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals—that's how we know we're getting it right.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About J & S

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs skimmed after taking up old carpet. Lads arrived on time, got the job done in two days, and the finish is absolutely spotless. They left the place tidy too. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Damp was wrecking my lounge walls. Steve came out, explained what needed doing without any waffle, and sorted it with a specialist tanking system. Six months on and it's bone dry. Brilliant value and honest advice.
reviews.author: Patricia W.

reviews.text: External render on our 1970s bungalow was cracking badly. J & S removed the old lot and applied a breathable finish. House looks brand new and no more damp patches inside. Top work.
reviews.author: David C.
